A='pk-lf-24d1dcc6-9a9b-4dbd-be01-2dfcd5e48c50:sk-lf-58d2045e-d8a6-4a6a-b6c9-8ac379c60fc9'; U=https://us.cloud.langfuse.com/api/public; curl -s -u "$A" "$U/traces?limit=2" | python3 -c '
import sys,json
for t in json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]:
  print(t["timestamp"], t["name"], "user", t.get("userId"), "tags", t.get("tags"), "meta", json.dumps(t.get("metadata"))[:300])'; curl -s -u "$A" "$U/observations?type=GENERATION&limit=50" | python3 -c '
import sys,json,collections
d=json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]; print(collections.Counter(o["name"] for o in d)); print("newest", d[0]["startTime"] if d else None)'; curl -s -u "$A" "$U/observations?type=GENERATION&limit=50&fromStartTime=2026-10-01T00:00:00Z" | python3 -c '
import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print([ (o["name"],o["startTime"]) for o in d["data"] if "jusprin" in (o["name"] or "")][:5])'
